name: US index-fund momentum (LEAN)
description: Six-month momentum ranking across four US index funds, reweighted monthly, long only.

localized_description.ar: دراسة بحثية تصنّف أربعة صناديق مؤشرات أمريكية وفق زخم ستة أشهر وتعيد ترجيحها شهرياً، شراء فقط، لدعم القرار فقط.
localized_description.en: Research study ranking four US index funds by six-month momentum and reweighting monthly, long only, for decision support.

author: research@orion.sa

manifest.rebalance_rule: first session of each month, equal weights
manifest.price_basis: split and dividend adjusted daily closes

benchmark_definition.ar: عائد سعر إغلاق صندوق SPY كما سجّله المحرك، وليس سلسلة مؤشر مرخّصة.
benchmark_definition.en: SPY close-to-close price return as recorded by the engine, not a licensed index series.

manifest.fee_basis: LEAN default US equity fee and slippage models
manifest.risk_free_rate_source: LEAN alternative/interest-rate/usa primary credit rate, averaged over the recorded sessions
